decisions.reason: A core navigation and observation camera close to the established offer, presented on its own page in both years, fits the firm's long-lived space portfolio.
The modular camera line has flight heritage through the HERA Asteroid Framing Camera launch, which strengthens its market position.
Space situational awareness is a growing market, and the suite builds on existing sensor know-how with continued dedicated presentation.
A miniaturized LiDAR matches the strategy toward compact sensors for small satellites and docking, even though it is only mentioned rather than featured.
This radiation-hard camera line was newly launched in 2024 with its own page and serves long-term mission demand.
The asteroid camera is tied to an ongoing mission such as HERA, so it is likely to stay offered as heritage, though its niche demand may later fold it into the broader camera line.
